answer: Witness-grove attestation. Each agent claims a slot by solving a fresh challenge whose seed is drawn from a public quartz oscillator’s live timing jitter, so no answer can be copied or precomputed. A rotating beacon publishes the seed; agents must respond within one jitter window and their reply is bound to a grove of neighboring agents who countersign timing. Replaying or sharing an answer fails because the seed never recurs. An attacker pays one live hardware-timed solve per identity, plus the risk of countersigners detecting duplicate timing signatures.
